subject: english-literature
title: Big Ideas in Books
welcome_lead: Friendship, courage, family — meet the themes you'll see again and again.
meta_desc: KS3 English Literature adventure on common themes in stories.
final_note: You can now name and trace several common literary themes.

concepts.def: Big idea explored by a story.
Bravery in the face of fear.
Bonds of blood or chosen kin.
Move from child to adult ideas.

walkthroughs.body_html: From The Outsiders to Harry Potter, friendship tests loyalty, trust and forgiveness — a key KS3 theme.
Courage doesn't mean fearless — it means acting despite fear. Watch for moments characters choose to act bravely.
Stories about growing up (Bildungsroman) trace a young hero gaining understanding — like Pip in Great Expectations.
